37423-how-we-think.title: How We Think
37423-how-we-think.creator: John Dewey
37423-how-we-think.description: A book by John Dewey. n our lips than _thinking_ and _thought_. So profuse and varied, indeed, is our use of these words that it is not easy to define just what we mean by them. The aim of this chapter is to find a single consistent meaning. Assistance may be had by considering some typical ways in which the terms are employed.

8853-weymouth-new-testament-in-modern-sp.title: Weymouth New Testament In Modern Speech Jude
8853-weymouth-new-testament-in-modern-sp.creator: Unknown
8853-weymouth-new-testament-in-modern-sp.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. 001:009 But Michael the Archangel, when contending with the Devil  and arguing with him about the body of Moses, did not dare  to pronounce judgement on him in abusive terms, but simply said,  "The Lord rebuke you."

arxiv-1506-06046.title: Face Prediction Model for an Automatic Age-invariant Face Recognition System
arxiv-1506-06046.creator: Poonam Yadav
arxiv-1506-06046.description: Abstract Automated face recognition and identification softwares are becoming part of our daily life; it finds its abode not only with Facebook’s auto photo tagging, Apple’s iPhoto, Google’s Picasa, Microsoft’s Kinect, but also in Homeland Security Department’s dedicated biometric face detection systems. Most of these automatic face identification systems fail where the effects of aging come into the picture.

arxiv-2112-05175.title: General quantum Chinos games
arxiv-2112-05175.creator: Daniel Centeno and Germán Sierra Instituto de Física Teórica UAM-CSIC, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, Cantoblanco, Madrid, Spain
arxiv-2112-05175.description: Abstract The Chinos game is a non-cooperative game between players who try to guess the total sum of coins drawn collectively. Semiclassical and quantum versions of this game were proposed by F. Guinea and M. A. Martín-Delgado, in J. Phys. A: Math. Gen.

arxiv-2206-02750.title: Recombination mechanism for 𝑫 𝟎 \bm{D^{0}} -meson production and 𝑫 𝟎 − 𝑫 𝟎 ¯ \bm{D^{0}\!-\!\overline{D^{0}}} production asymmetry in the LHCb 𝒑 + 𝟐𝟎 𝑵 𝒆 \bm{p\!+\!\!^{20}\!N\!e} fixed-target experiment
arxiv-2206-02750.creator: Rafał Maciuła, Antoni Szczurek
arxiv-2206-02750.description: Abstract We discuss production of neutral D D mesons in proton-proton collisions at the LHC (fixed target mode) in the framework of the BJM recombination model. We present rapidity and transverse momentum distributions of D D mesons and compare the recombination contribution to the dominant gluon-gluon fusion mechanism.

arxiv-2303-11192.title: Multimodal Shannon Game with Images
arxiv-2303-11192.creator: Vilém Zouhar 0★, Sunit Bhattacharya ★, Ondřej Bojar
arxiv-2303-11192.description: Abstract The Shannon game has long been used as a thought experiment in linguistics and NLP, asking participants to guess the next letter in a sentence based on its preceding context. We extend the game by introducing an optional extra modality in the form of image information.

arxiv-2307-05485.title: Mechanism of deflagration-to-detonation transition in gas
arxiv-2307-05485.creator: Paul Clavin Aix Marseille Université, CNRS, Centrale Marseille, IRPHE, UMR7342, 49 rue Joliot Curie, BP 146, 13384 Marseille Cedex 13, France
arxiv-2307-05485.description: Abstract The deflagration-to-detonation transition on the tip of an elongated flame in a tube is shown to be related to a dynamical saddle-node bifurcation of the inner flame structure leading to a runaway of the pressure in finite time. The comparison with the experiments shows a good agreement. .

arxiv-2309-00585.title: PolyGET: Accelerating Polymer Simulations by Accurate and Generalizable Forcefield with Equivariant Transformer
arxiv-2309-00585.creator: Rui Feng, Huan Tran, Aubrey Toland, Binghong Chen, Qi Zhu, Rampi Ramprasad, Chao Zhang
arxiv-2309-00585.description: Abstract Polymer simulation with both accuracy and efficiency is a challenging task. Machine learning (ML) forcefields have been developed to achieve both the accuracy of ab initio methods and the efficiency of empirical force fields. However, existing ML force fields are usually limited to single-molecule settings, and their simulations are not robust enough.

arxiv-2401-05981.title: Propagating terrace in a two-tubes model of gravitational fingering YP and ST have equal contribution
arxiv-2401-05981.creator: Yu. Petrova, S. Tikhomirov, Ya. Efendiev
arxiv-2401-05981.description: Abstract We study a semi-discrete model for the two-dimensional incompressible porous medium (IPM) equation describing gravitational fingering phenomenon. The model consists of a system of advection-reaction-diffusion equations on concentration, velocity and pressure, describing motion of miscible liquids under the Darcy’s law in two vertical tubes (real lines) and interflow between them.

arxiv-2401-14833.title: Accretion, greybody factor, quasinormal modes, power spectrum, sparsity of Hawking radiation, and weak gravitational lensing of a minimum measurable length inspired Schwarzchild black hole
arxiv-2401-14833.creator: Himangshu Barman, Ahmad Al-Badawi, Sohan Kumar Jha, Anisur Rahaman
arxiv-2401-14833.description: Abstract In this manuscript, we delve into an analytic and numerical probe of shadow with different accretion models, quasinormal modes, Hawking radiation, and gravitational lensing to study observational impacts of quantum effect introduced throughh linear-quadratic GUP(LQG). Our investigation reveals that the shadows of LQG modified black holes are smaller and brighter than Schwarzschild black holes.

arxiv-2508-03341.title: Nemori: Self-Organizing Agent Memory Inspired by Cognitive Science
arxiv-2508-03341.creator: Jiayan Nan, Wenquan Ma, Wenlong Wu, Yize Chen
arxiv-2508-03341.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities, yet their inability to maintain persistent memory in long contexts limits their effectiveness as autonomous agents in long-term interactions. While existing memory systems have made progress, their reliance on arbitrary granularity for defining the basic memory unit and passive, rule-based mechanisms for knowledge extraction limits their capacity for genuine learning and evolution.

arxiv-2509-14843.title: On the Multiary Algebraic Formulation of an Idempotent Symmetric Limit Convex Structure
arxiv-2509-14843.creator: Walter Briec
arxiv-2509-14843.description: Abstract In [ 14 ] , 𝔹 \mathbb{B} -convexity was defined as an appropriate Painlevé-Kuratowski limit of linear convexities. More recently, an alternative algebraic formulation over the entire Euclidean vector space was proposed in [ 9 ] and [ 10 ] .

arxiv-2512-04734.title: MT-Depth: Multi-task Instance feature analysis for the Depth Completion
arxiv-2512-04734.creator: Abdul Haseeb Nizamani, Dandi Zhou, Xinhai Sun
arxiv-2512-04734.description: Abstract Depth completion plays a vital role in 3D perception systems, especially in scenarios where sparse depth data must be densified for tasks such as autonomous driving, robotics, and augmented reality. While many existing approaches rely on semantic segmentation to guide depth completion, they often overlook the benefits of object-level understanding.

pmc-11306682.title: Acute Abdomen as a Clinical Presentation of COVID-19-Associated Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children
pmc-11306682.creator: Elmira Hajiesmaeil Memar, Fatemeh Tahghighi, Sedigheh Yousefzadegan, Parisa Sadeghirad, Ashraf Mousavi, Ramin Zare Mahmoudabadi, Hossein Saeidi, Mehri Ayati, Sahar Naderi, Sara Memarian, Seyedmusa Zeinalabedin, Bahar Ashjaei, Hojatollah Raji, Leila Tahernia, Hosein Alimadadi, Vahid Ziaee
pmc-11306682.description: Background On December 2019, a novel coronavirus disease (COVID-19) spread worldwide and became a pandemic. Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C) due to cytokine release syndrome following COVID-19 presents with various manifestations. We hypothesize that one of the rare manifestations is acute abdomen. Case Presentation.

pmc-11327760.title: Estimating effects of monsoon flooding on household water access
pmc-11327760.creator: Lauren M T Broyles, Emily L Pakhtigian, Alfonso Mejia
pmc-11327760.description: The importance of climate in water resources management is well recognized, but less is known about how climate affects water access at the household level. Understanding this is crucial for identifying vulnerable households, reducing health and well-being risks, and finding equitable solutions.

pmc-11328606.title: Surface functionalized nanomaterial systems for targeted therapy of endocrine related tumors: a review of recent advancements
pmc-11328606.creator: Limei Liu, Miao Yang, Ziyang Chen
pmc-11328606.description: The application of multidisciplinary techniques in the management of endocrine-related cancers is crucial for harnessing the advantages of multiple disciplines and their coordinated efforts in eliminating tumors. Due to the malignant characteristics of cancer cells, they possess the capacity to develop resistance to traditional treatments such as chemotherapy and radiotherapy.

pmc-11517754.title: COVID-19 premature mortality in Serbia: Does the place of death matter?
pmc-11517754.creator: A Stevanović, M Šantrić-Milićević, J Todorović, N Rajović, N Rosić, G Bjelobrk
pmc-11517754.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic has significantly impacted healthcare services provision in Serbia and globally. Many people did not seek or reach healthcare due to various reasons, and a significant number of COVID-19 deaths were not confirmed by laboratory testing.

pmc-11518830.title: Computational identification of Vernonia cinerea-derived phytochemicals as potential inhibitors of nonstructural protein 1 (NSP1) in dengue virus serotype-2
pmc-11518830.creator: Md. Shohel Hossain, Soharth Hasnat, Shilpy Akter, Maria Mulla Mim, Anika Tahcin, Majedul Hoque, Durjoy Sutradhar, Mst. Alifa Akter Keya, Namin Rouf Sium, Sophia Hossain, Runa Masuma, Sakhawat Hossen Rakib, Md. Aminul Islam, Tofazzal Islam, Prosun Bhattacharya, M. Nazmul Hoque
pmc-11518830.description: BackgroundDengue virus (DENV) infection, spread by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, is a significant public health concern in tropical and subtropical regions. Among the four distinct serotypes of DENV (DENV-1 to DENV-4), DENV-2 is associated with the highest number of fatalities worldwide. However, there is no specific treatment available for dengue patients caused by DENV-2.

pmc-11613236.title: Crystal Lattice-Induced Stress modulates Photoinduced Jahn–Teller Distortion Dynamics
pmc-11613236.creator: Vandana Tiwari, Marcus Gallagher-Jones, Hyein Hwang, Hong-Guang Duan, Angus I. Kirkland, R. J. Dwayne Miller, Ajay Jha
pmc-11613236.description: Efficient photoredox chemical transformations are essential to the development of novel, cost-effective, and environmentally friendly synthetic methodologies. The concept of the entatic state in bioinorganic catalysis proposes that a preorganized structural configuration can reduce the energy barriers associated with chemical reactions.

pmc-11696600.title: Incidence, healthcare and out-of-pocket costs, and mortality of Clostridioides difficile infection among US adults aged 18 to 64 years
pmc-11696600.creator: Holly Yu, Tamuno Alfred, Jingying Zhou, Jennifer Judy, Margaret A Olsen
pmc-11696600.description: Objective:To estimate incidence and healthcare costs and mortality associated with Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) among adults <65 years old.Design:Retrospective cohort study.Patients:First CDI episodes among commercially insured US patients 18–64 years old were identified from a large claims database. CDI+ patients were propensity score−matched (PSM) 1:1 with CDI− controls using clinically relevant variables including comorbidities.

pmc-11709423.title: Isolated Ophthalmoplegia: An Uncommon Presentation of Anti-glutamic Acid Decarboxylase 65 (Anti-GAD65) Neurological Syndrome
pmc-11709423.creator: Roberto A Cruz, Oscar Gutierrez Treviño
pmc-11709423.description: Isolated ophthalmoplegia as an anti-glutamic acid decarboxylase 65 (anti-GAD65) antibody-associated neurological syndrome is rare. We present a case of a 22-year-old pregnant Hispanic female patient who presented initially with a left oculomotor nerve palsy following an emergency department (ED) visit for migraine headache. Brain imaging was done with no important findings.

pmc-11758898.title: Comparison over Time of Adverse Drug Reactions in Diabetes Patients Treated with Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2 Inhibitors
pmc-11758898.creator: MAI UEDA, MASAKO ZENIBAYASHI, TOMOKO YAMADA, SHUN-ICHIRO ASAHARA, WATARU OGAWA
pmc-11758898.description: BACKGROUNDSThe prescription of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors have been increasing due to their additional benefits, including weight loss, cardioprotection and renoprotection. Accordingly, there are concerns about the potential rise in severe adverse drug reactions (ADRs), such as urinary tract infections, diabetic ketoacidosis, volume depletion, and hypoglycemia. The Society has announced recommendations on the proper use of SGLT2 inhibitors.

pmc-13156584.title: Inferior mesenteric vein thrombosis in an elderly woman with antiphospholipid syndrome: A case report and review of the literature
pmc-13156584.creator: Ian Seng Lam, Hoi Ip Leong, Tam Fei Chang
pmc-13156584.description: Inferior mesenteric vein (IMV) thrombosis is a rare but potentially fatal subset of mesenteric venous thrombosis (MVT). We report a 75-year-old woman presenting with epigastric pain, fever, and Escherichia coli bacteremia, found to have isolated Inferior mesenteric vein thrombosis on contrast-enhanced computed tomography. Conservative management with bowel rest, anticoagulation, and antibiotics led to clinical improvement and partial thrombus regression.

pmc-13457786.title: Vaccine Handling Management in Korea, Japan, and Taiwan: A Comparative Study of Storage Standards, Implementation Practices, and Regulatory Approaches
pmc-13457786.creator: Cho Ryok Kang, Ji Yun Noh, Won Suk Choi, Young June Choe, Hajime Kamiya, Seiichi Tomotaki, Hiroko Tomotaki, Li-Min Huang, Sumyeong Choe, Young Hwa Lee, Nam-Kyong Choi, Heehyun Won, Suyeon Jeong, Jong-Koo Lee
pmc-13457786.description: BackgroundRobust vaccine cold-chain management safeguards potency and public trust. Korea, Japan, and Taiwan share core practices (2–8°C storage, continuous monitoring, first-expiry-first-out [FEFO] stock rotation) yet differ in implementation and governance. We compared standards and real-world practices across the three systems to identify actionable improvements for Korea.

pmc-13629150.title: Accuracy of Kane, Hill-RBF, and PEARL-DGS versus traditional IOL formulas in highly myopic eyes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13629150.creator: Hong Chang, Yu Wang, Fei Qi
pmc-13629150.description: PurposeTo evaluate the accuracy of Kane, Hill-RBF, and PEARL-DGS compared with traditional intraocular lens (IOL) formulas in highly myopic eyes undergoing cataract surgery.MethodsA systematic review registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261372807) and conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 evaluated studies comparing Kane, Hill-RBF, and/or PEARL-DGS with conventional IOL formulas in highly myopic eyes.

pmc-13632051.title: Microbial ecological mechanism of Blumea balsamifera residue promoting fermentation quality and improving feed value of Pennisetum silage
pmc-13632051.creator: Xuejuan Zi, Shuo Wu, Kai Wang, Mao Li
pmc-13632051.description: Background Pennisetum is the most widely used forage in tropical regions around the world but its silage preservation is often challenged by high temperature, humidity, and the proliferation of undesirable bacteria. Blumea balsamifera (L.) DC., a native medicinal plant and industrial crop, produces residues with notable antibacterial and antioxidant properties, suggesting potential as a silage additive.

pmc-13637377.title: Novel inflammatory indices compared with CRP for diagnosing pelvic inflammatory disease: a case-control study
pmc-13637377.creator: Jingwen Kong, Jingjing Zhao, Xiaohui Sun, Chen Yang, Ling Tang
pmc-13637377.description: Background and objectivesPelvic inflammatory disease (PID) is a common upper genital tract infection associated with serious long-term sequelae. Its clinical diagnosis is challenging due to non-specific symptoms, creating an urgent need for accurate, accessible biomarkers. While C-reactive protein (CRP) is commonly used, its specificity is limited.

pmc-535701.title: Short Sleep Duration Is Associated with Reduced Leptin, Elevated Ghrelin, and Increased Body Mass Index
pmc-535701.creator: Shahrad Taheri, Ling Lin, Diane Austin et al.
pmc-535701.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). Sleep duration may be an important regulator of body weight and metabolism. An association between short habitual sleep time and increased body mass index (BMI) has been reported in large population samples. The potential role of metabolic hormones in this association is unknown.
